name: shougong-monorepo
description: Task runner for the shougong monorepo (backend/ + frontend/). Not a real Node package — just scripts. Use `just`/`make` equivalents if you install them.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm run be:sync
scripts.be:run: cd backend && uv run poe run
scripts.be:check: cd backend && uv run poe check
scripts.be:test: cd backend && uv run poe test
scripts.check: npm run be:check && npm run fe:typecheck && npm run fe:build
